# Trip.com Singapore

> > Trip.com Singapore is a comprehensive travel booking platform offering flights, hotels, apartments, and train tickets across global destinations.

Trip.com serves the Singapore market with extensive accommodation options including hotel deals, apartment rentals, and vacation properties across Asia-Pacific, Europe, Americas, and Africa. The platform features verified reviews, 24/7 customer support, and booking discounts for destinations ranging from major cities like Tokyo, Singapore, and Delhi to emerging markets across multiple continents.

## Key Topics

- Trip.com
- Singapore travel bookings
- Hotel deals and discounts
- Apartment rentals
- Vacation rentals
- Accommodation booking platform
- Asia-Pacific destinations (Japan, Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, Maldives)
- International travel (Australia, France, Costa Rica)
- Trip.Planner
- Flight bookings
- Train tickets
- Verified reviews
- 24/7 customer support
- Travel discounts
- Global accommodation search
